name: claim-autofill-extension
description: Chrome extension that fills approved amounts from claim amounts and audits RGHS bundled packages for unbundling

scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && git config commit.template .gitmessage
scripts.check: python tools/validate-matrix-coverage.py && node --check build.js && node --check audit-rules.js && node --check custom-rules.js && node --check audit-core.js && node --check auth-core.js && node --check claim-core.js && node --check review-core.js && node --check content.js && node --check background.js && node --check options.js && node --check floating-widget.js && node --check popup.js && node --check scripts/live-browser-smoke.js && node --check scripts/release.js && node --test "tests/*.test.js"
scripts.watch: nodemon --watch . --ignore dist --ignore tests -e js,html,css,json --exec npm run build
